author: No Thanks TJ

content:
Wish I could have written two reviews.  The first one would be a five for the fun the game provides.  It’s been a long while since I have found a game that kept my inner child attention.

The second review would be a big fat one.  I had several issues so I emailed them.  No response until I sent a second email.  When they finally responded they asked for more details.  I provided the details and suggested a option where I didn’t need to get my money back but after all that they sent me a “sorry but we can’t issue refunds” email and directed me to who might.  They mentioned nothing about my fair suggestion on how we could handle the money issue.  It left me feeling that that was going to be their response no matter what.  I was disappointed.  

I’m not going to push to get my $25 back.  It never was about the money.  It was an offer to make things right.  That said, they will never get another cent from me and if they bothered to look they would have seen that as a very new subscriber I was spending a little bit of money every few days.  

For those of you who stuck with me to read this review, thank you.  Enjoy the game.  The glitches are few but there are some.  While I did get a couple responses from them those responses lacked little interest in helping me out.  Great game, not so great customer relations.

author: Mohammad Tourjoman

content: I only give it three stars because the game itself is pretty well built and actually mostly fun to play - when it allows you to play, that is. But once I got to the second level, a ‘tickets’ counter appeared that limited the number of runs you can do to 20, and if you wanna play more you have to wait 20 minutes per ticket or pay even more money to get a few tickets to keep playing. Ridiculously greedy honestly. Additionally, the ads on instagram were misleading - they showed much more interesting levels with floating tracks, a lot of jumps, and a lot of momentum. In the actual game, you’re sledding on high friction snowy terrain with little variety, you don’t cover much distance during any given level. It’s so close to being a fantastic game. Fix the ticket system and make longer, more interesting levels with ability to choose what level you wanna play, and you’ll have a best seller.

author: Lbotowey
title: Fun game
content:
I’ve been playing this game for a long time and really like it. I got my husband hooked on it too. After playing for a year or so I quit playing it for a long time because I it gets tedious having to start at zero every time you advance to another level. After watching all those ads to triple my coins, only to have them taken away when I pass the level is frustrating. You only get 15 tries a day unless you pay. Why should I have to pay to play your game? Charge for other things like up grades but not for us just to play your game.  There are people who can’t afford to pay , so they only get to have 15 turns a day. It takes many tries and a lot of sling shot and sled upgrades to get anywhere. The steering of the sled does not work very well. It’s not very sensitive so it makes you crash and use one of your 15 tries for the day.  It takes forever to upgrade enough times that you’re able to get to the end and pass the level only to have to start all over again and lose all your progress at the next level. It makes no sense and I assume causes a lot of people to delete the game. 
If developers were to fix these few things this game would be awesome. 
On a positive note, even though there are ads every 3 runs at least you can click out of them really quick. If you choose to watch an ad to triple your coins, they are a little longer. But overall the ads are not long or too many. 
One more thing. The original penguin is the cutest character. The others are really weird. It would be good if you had more cute little animal characters but that’s not a huge deal breaker.

title: Fun game, but premium purchases DISAPPEAR overnight!
content:

I bought the Penguin Bank, which gave me 24 tickets. I used some the first day and decided to save the rest for the next day when I had more time to play. When the next day rolled around, I opened the game and found that all my leftover purchased tickets were totally gone. The counter was reset to just the standard 20 free daily tickets.

Apparently, the ticket capacity completely resets every single morning. Anything you bought the day before that you didn't use is immediately wiped out. 

This is not conducive to keeping customers! Sure, it's only a little over a couple of bucks, but it's my money. What gives the developers the right to steal it back? If you are going to blatantly erase purchases, put a warning disclaimer on the Penguin Bank so players know up front!

author: Jason K R
title: Progression between levels - an idea?
content:
Love the game. One thing I’d really like to see is some form of progression between levels where the upgrades you earn carry over instead of being reset every time.

Starting from scratch on each level can be a little discouraging, especially because I often enjoy staying on a particular map for a while and experimenting with how far I can push my upgrades. Sometimes I’ll even intentionally die before reaching the finish just so I can keep playing that map.

Maybe there could be certain levels or game modes where your upgrades persist, allowing you to keep progressing and explore further and further. I think that could add a really fun sense of long-term progression while still keeping the current level-based system.

author: PennySparkles
title: So Sad

You can't even dress up the penguin, the other characters are just humans in costumes?? So weird... Could've just made them other animals and that would've been way cuter. I enjoyed upgrading and trying to get better but after reading reviews and learning that your upgrades restart at the start of each level feels like robbery. So you just take money from people on the first level and basically rob them. This game is barely worth $5 to play, let alone $10-$40. Greedy asf and honestly just could've been better. The ads made it look so much more fun and way cuter. The "upgrades" feel like they get weaker the longer you play with them then magically get better again?? Overall I was excited to play a cute penguin sledding game and got disappointed. The fact that I know I'll have to restart my upgrades at the next level now is making me uninstall.
